result.instructions: Tools for Particle Health, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Particle Health data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run particlehealth_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run particlehealth_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run particlehealth_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. particlehealth_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: particle_get_patient
tools.title: Get patient record
tools.description: Fetch a single patient record by its Particle patient id. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}.

tools.name: particle_search_patient
tools.title: Search for a patient
tools.description: Search for an existing patient by demographics (non-mutating). Returns an array of matching patient objects (or a 204 message when none match). Endpoint: POST /api/v2/patients/search.

patient_id.description: Your own external identifier for this patient (echoed back by Particle).

address_city.description: City of the patient's home address.

address_state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. NY.

address_lines.description: Street address lines, e.g. ["123 Main St"].

ssn.description: Social Security Number (optional; improves demographic match quality).

consent.description: Consent objects, if required by your Particle data-sharing agreement.

tools.name: particle_get_query_status
tools.title: Get query status
tools.description: Get the status of a clinical-record retrieval query (state, timing, demographics, files). Omit query_id to get the latest COMPLETE query. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/query.

query_id.description: Specific query id; omit for the latest COMPLETE query.

tools.name: particle_get_fhir
tools.title: Get FHIR bundle
tools.description: Retrieve the patient's complete clinical record as a FHIR searchset Bundle. Supports incremental sync and pagination. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/fhir.

_since.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only return resources updated since then.

_page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous page's `link` to fetch the next page.

tools.name: particle_get_fhir_by_type
tools.title: Get FHIR resources by type
tools.description: Retrieve only one FHIR resource type for a patient (e.g. Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation) as a Bundle. Supports the same pagination as particle_get_fhir. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/fhir/{type}.

resource_type.description: FHIR resource type, e.g. Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation, AllergyIntolerance.

_since.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only return resources updated since then.

_page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous page's `link` to fetch the next page.

tools.name: particle_get_flat
tools.title: Get flattened clinical data
tools.description: Retrieve the patient's clinical data in Particle's flattened (de-nested) format, easier to read than raw FHIR. Optionally filter to one domain. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/flat.

_since.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only return data updated since then.

domain.description: Filter to a single clinical domain, e.g. Condition, Medication, Encounter.

tools.name: particle_get_ccda
tools.title: Get C-CDA document(s)
tools.description: Retrieve the patient's C-CDA clinical document(s). May be large and returned as XML/text — parsed if JSON, otherwise passed through as-is. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/ccda.

tools.name: particle_search_network_participants
tools.title: Search network participants
tools.description: List the health-data network participants (organizations Particle can query). Optionally filter by state or zipcode, and page with continuation_token. Endpoint: GET /api/v1/networkparticipants (with /state/{state} and /zipcode/{zip} variants).

state.description: Two-letter US state code to filter participants, e.g. NY.

zipcode.description: 5-digit ZIP code to filter participants (ignored if `state` is set).

continuation_token.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: particle_get_patient_documents
tools.title: List patient documents
tools.description: List the documents uploaded / available for a patient. Endpoint: GET /api/v1/documents/{patient_id}.

patient_id.description: Patient id whose documents to list.

tools.name: particle_submit_patient
tools.title: Submit (register) patient (WRITE)
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE: register a new patient with Particle Health. Returns the patient with a system-generated particle_patient_id (use it for subsequent queries). Endpoint: POST /api/v2/patients.

patient_id.description: Your own external identifier for this patient (echoed back by Particle).

address_city.description: City of the patient's home address.

address_state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. NY.

address_lines.description: Street address lines, e.g. ["123 Main St"].

ssn.description: Social Security Number (optional; improves demographic match quality).

consent.description: Consent objects, if required by your Particle data-sharing agreement.

tools.name: particle_create_query
tools.title: Create clinical-record query (WRITE)
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE: initiate a nationwide clinical-record retrieval for a patient. Returns a query_id — poll particle_get_query_status for progress. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/query.

particle_patient_id.description: Particle-assigned patient id to run the query for.

purpose_of_use.description: Purpose of use for the request, e.g. TREATMENT.

hints.description: Postal codes to hint where records may be found.

specialties.description: Specialties to focus the query, e.g. ["ONCOLOGY"].
